helpPlay: p <idx>              Play the card at idx
rule: Suits do not matter at all. If you hold a card higher than the highest one played so far, you must play one of them; if you do not, you must play your lowest card. The only choice is which higher card to spend. The highest rank takes the trick -- but penalty points are scored only by whoever takes the LAST trick, equal to the rank of the card they took it with. Every other trick is worth nothing. Fewest penalty points wins.
promptLead: You lead. Any card is legal.
promptForced: You cannot beat it, so your lowest card is the only legal play.
promptRoundEnd: {{name}} took the last trick and scored {{n}} penalty points.
gameEndYou: Game over! You finished with the fewest penalty points ({{n}}).
gameEndCpu: Game over! {{name}} finished with the fewest penalty points ({{n}}).
